title: Google Ads Benchmarks for YOUR Industry [Updated!]

facts.fact: WordStream's own client data shows an average Google Ads search click-through rate of 3.17% across all industries.
facts.quote: The average click-through rate in Google Ads across all industries is 3.17% for search and 0.46% for display.

facts.fact: WordStream's own client data shows an average Google Ads Display Network click-through rate of 0.46% across all industries.
facts.quote: The average click-through rate in Google Ads across all industries is 3.17% for search and 0.46% for display.

facts.fact: WordStream's own client data shows an average Google Ads search cost per click of $2.69 across all industries.
facts.quote: The average cost per click in Google Ads across all industries is $2.69 for search and $0.63 for display.

facts.fact: WordStream's own client data shows an average Google Ads Display Network cost per click of $0.63 across all industries.
facts.quote: The average cost per click in Google Ads across all industries is $2.69 for search and $0.63 for display.

facts.fact: WordStream reports that its earlier averages, from a couple of years before the page was updated, were $2.32 search CPC and $0.58 Display CPC.
facts.quote: (when the averages were $2.32 and $0.58 respectively)
